input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Open research programme civ-seeding (track 24 draw: no open civ programme) and land milestone 1, a reproduction of Banerjee et al. (2013)'s information-model estimate on their CC0 data

errors.what: Harvard Dataverse download of the BCDJ archive refused without a guestbook form (name/email); read the same datav4.0 archive from a public GitHub mirror instead (ftschofenig/EmergentDirectedness) and recorded provenance in data/build_dataset.py
first test run: adoption-probability test used beta 5 (p = 0.993) and flaked by construction; changed to 50

doc_friction.issue: Track 24 draw said to open a programme but its 'next step' lookup found no Next steps section in civ-levers/civ-patterns; the actual open items live in PROJECTS.md's milestone notes, which it did not surface.

Says to attach a GitHub-hosted dataset with add_repo; for public repos add_repo only says read access is already available and to clone yourself. A sparse, blob-filtered clone (git clone --filter=blob:none --sparse) was what made a large mirror usable; worth a line.

deviations.why: Deep-tech direction asks new programmes to come from chips/robotics/energy etc.; the draw sent this run to track 24 (civ, a curiosity track by the owner's request). Opened the programme there anyway and framed the application as energy/farm technology rollouts, stating that transfer from microfinance is a hypothesis.
deviations.did: civ programme with a named deep-tech application section
deviations.result: proposal passes programme_check; application is honest but indirect

deviations.why: A proposal is a full session's work and counts; did the proposal plus milestone 1 (a real-data reproduction) in one PR since the data and the reproduction define the programme's baseline.

notes: Results: port reproduces take-up (0.187 vs 0.185; leaders 0.247 vs 0.248), qP>qN in 98.4% of 1000 bootstrap draws, and the qN=0 counterfactual (drop 0.337 vs 0.32), but the grid minimum is (0.05, 0.30) for three seeds vs published (0.10, 0.50), which scores 11x the minimum; qP 95% bootstrap interval [0.15, 1.0]. Post-hoc: two-step weights qP 0.20-0.25; quarters (0.05, 0.15); months (0.01, 0.10). 15/15 DOIs ok via cite_check. Local checks: pytest 10 passed; research/_homepage/build.py ok; check_md_links ok; programme_check ok; post frontmatter/links/similarity ok; run_workflow_locally --for-changes output in PR. No agent doc in docs/reports: LOG.md and README Next steps carry what the next run needs.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: data sourcing and conversion ~4h, port of the BCDJ Matlab estimator with tests ~8h, grid/bootstrap runs and robustness ~4h, proposal with 15 checked references ~6h, write-up ~2h

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
